rationale: The original thesis remains intact — price is still above rising VWAP ($31.82) and the 9-EMA, consolidating in an even tighter band just under the high of day with volume drying up (last bars ~2-15k vs. 28-33k earlier) and zero distribution, while maximum adverse excursion of just -0.02% confirms sellers have never pressured the position.
